# clavis env freeze

<p class="cli-lead">Schedule a write freeze for the linked environment</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis env freeze [flags]
```

</div>

Schedule a window in which secret writes, promotions, syncs and overlay edits are blocked for the linked environment, for example during a release.

## Examples

```sh
clavis env freeze --reason "Release freeze" --hours 4
clavis env freeze --start 2026-11-27T09:00:00Z --hours 8 --reason "Black Friday"
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-hours"><dt><code>--hours int</code></dt><dd>freeze duration in hours <span class="cli-default">Default: <code>4</code></span></dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-reason"><dt><code>--reason string</code></dt><dd>why the environment is frozen</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-start"><dt><code>--start string</code></dt><dd>start time in RFC3339 (default now)</dd></div>
</dl>
